en.headline: Customs seize about 6kg of suspected cocaine from Filipino passenger at airport
en.dek: A 22-year-old woman arriving from Phnom Penh was arrested and charged with drug trafficking; the case is due in court on Monday.
body: Hong Kong Customs said it detected a drug trafficking case involving an incoming passenger at Hong Kong International Airport on Saturday and seized about 6 kilograms of suspected cocaine with an estimated market value of about HK$3.6 million.
A 22-year-old Filipino female passenger arrived from Phnom Penh, Cambodia. During clearance, officers found the suspected cocaine in her check-in suitcase and arrested her.

The woman has been charged with one count of trafficking in a dangerous drug. The case will be brought at the West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts on Monday. Customs said it would continue intelligence-led enforcement against such trafficking.

zh.headline: 海關在機場檢獲約6公斤懷疑可卡因 拘菲籍女旅客
zh.dek: 22歲女子由金邊抵港，已被控販運危險藥物，案件明日在西九龍裁判法院提堂。
body: 香港海關表示，周六在香港國際機場偵破一宗涉及入境旅客的販毒案件，檢獲約6公斤懷疑可卡因，估計市值約360萬元。
一名22歲菲律賓籍女旅客由柬埔寨金邊飛抵本港。清關時，人員在其寄艙行李箱內發現該批懷疑可卡因，隨即將她拘捕。
該女子已被控一項販運危險藥物罪，案件將於周一在西九龍裁判法院提堂。海關表示會繼續加強情報主導執法打擊有關活動。
